judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a wooden barrel with visible vertical planks and two horizontal metal hoops.
requirements.note: Three metal hoops are strapped across the barrel body, not two.

requirements.text: The barrel must be buried in a mound of sand, so only the top half is visible.
requirements.note: More than the top half shows: the barrel stands about 425 px tall above the dune against a drawn width of about 437 px (ratio 0.97, where half a barrel is roughly 0.7 of its width), and its lower-left base curve is drawn above the sand.

requirements.text: Show the sand mounded up slightly around the visible base of the barrel.
The barrel must be open at the top and filled with treasure items.
Show treasure overflowing from the top and spilling down one side of the barrel onto the sand.
requirements.note: Nothing overflows the rim and nothing spills down any side of the barrel; the three coins and two pearls on the dune are isolated objects with no trail connecting them to the barrel.

requirements.text: The treasure must include a large pile of shiny gold coins, both inside and outside the barrel.
requirements.note: Outside the barrel there are only three isolated coins scattered on the dune, which is not a large pile.

requirements.text: Add a variety of colorful gemstones (red rubies, green emeralds, blue sapphires) mixed in with the coins.
requirements.note: Neither green nor blue is present: the two non-red gems are teal (46,188,163, hue 169 degrees) and the other two are crimson, so there is no green emerald and no blue sapphire.

requirements.text: A string of white pearls must be draped over the edge of the barrel, trailing down into the spilled coins.
requirements.note: The pearls are three loose beads lying among the coins inside the barrel and two more sitting on the dune; there is no string, and nothing is draped over the barrel's edge.

requirements.text: A golden goblet must be visible, partially buried in the coins inside the barrel.
requirements.note: No goblet appears anywhere in the render.

requirements.text: Use bright highlights and glint effects on the coins, gems, and goblet to make them look shiny.
requirements.note: There is no goblet in the render, so the required glint on the goblet cannot be present.
